report.description: Podio is a collaborative work platform that provides customizable workspaces, apps, and API access for managing items, tasks, and user data.

evidence.claim: Podio uses OAuth2 and app‑token flows for authentication, and developers can obtain API keys via the developer portal.
App authentication flow documentation shows how to programmatically acquire app tokens.
Free plan provides API access (1,000 calls per day) without contacting sales, indicating self‑serve credential acquisition.
Podio MCP Server enables Model Context Protocol integration for AI assistants.
Comprehensive API reference covering items, applications, users, and more demonstrates broad REST API coverage.
